verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer site says apps can 'receive notifications for any changes in Dropbox using webhooks', and there is a dedicated Webhooks API reference page, so the product itself offers outbound HTTP change notifications. The pack shows only these two thin mentions, without the registration flow, payload structure, event types or verification details, so complete coverage cannot be confirmed. missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription process, event types and payload schema, signature verification/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
